takeaway: NQ trended higher all day: the Nasdaq was up ~1.4% late (~26,530) as chips led for a 3rd session (AVGO +4.6%, AMD +4%) on the Anthropic IPO/AI bid. Oil fell ~2% (WTI under $100, Brent under $110) on Iran de-escalation talks, and VIX slipped to ~17.6, but the 10Y is still pinned at ~5%. FOMC day 1 is done; the decision is Wed 2:00 PM with Warsh at 2:30 (hold expected, ~10% hike odds). NXPI, STX, HOOD, V and TER report tonight; MSFT/GOOGL Wed AMC.
